name: Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry with Noodles, Mushrooms, Bell Pepper & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse.
Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot with drippings for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ red bell peppers
3 crowns broccoli
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Return pot (with drippings) to medium heat. Once the pot is hot, add veggies, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the veggies are cooking, place soy sauce, water, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and cornstarch in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim green onions and cut crosswise into thin pieces.
Once the sauce has thickened, add drained noodles, chicken, and green onions to the pot. Toss to combine and continue to cook until warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
